{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the column for baseline biomarker
print("Column name for baseline biomarker:", df.columns[df.columns.str.contains('biomarker_baseline', case=False)].tolist())

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value
mean_baseline = df['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value: {mean_baseline}")"}
